title: wu-2008-world
label: Requiem

title: wu-2008-short-circuit
label: David Gunn

won.source: Its Short Circuit page (headed Contender Championship History): 'David Gunn. See No Evil: September 14th 2008. Defeated Hyde, Eric Draven, Marquise, and Chris Legend. Successful Title Defenses 3. Lost The Bleeding: October 19th 2008 to Porter MaCleod'.

how: Won at See No Evil, the first Short Circuit champion, with three defences.

title: wu-2008-short-circuit
label: Porter MaCleod

won.source: Its Short Circuit page: 'Porter MaCleod. The Bleeding: October 19th 2008. Defeated David Gunn'; its Rankings page of 21 October lists him as Prime Time champion.

how: Won at The Bleeding from David Gunn; the belt became the Prime Time Championship.

title: wu-2008-one-shot
label: Chad Vargas

won.source: Its One Shot page: 'Chad Vargas. See No Evil: September 14th 2008. Defeated Cameron Drake and Troy Gafgen. Successful Title Defenses 4. Lost October 13th, Parental Advisory to Skull Daze'.

how: Won at See No Evil, the first Contender champion, with four defences.
note: The page's own date for the title change is 13 October; the third Parental Advisory is headed 12 October.

title: wu-2008-one-shot
label: Skull Daze

won.source: Its One Shot page: 'Skull Daze. October 13th, Parental Advisory. Defeated Chad Vargas. Successful Title Defenses 5 (All Chad's 4 was awarded to Skull). Cashed in for WU Title Shot on October 13th'.

how: Won by cashing in; the page counts Chad Vargas's four defences to him.
note: The page says he cashed the title in for a WU title shot on 13 October, the same day as his win.

title: wu-2008-one-shot
label: Twilight Rayn

won.source: Its One Shot page: 'Twilight Rayn. The Bleeding: October 19th 2008. Defeated Nigel, Drake Daniels, David Gunn. Successful Title Defenses 3. Lost November 17th, Parental Advisory to Troy Gafgen'.

how: Won at The Bleeding in a four-way, with three defences.

title: wu-2008-one-shot
label: Troy Gafgen

won.source: Its One Shot page: 'Troy Gafgen. November 17th, Parental Advisory. Defeated Twilight Rayn. Successful Title Defenses 1. Lost December 8, 2008 to CJ Gates'.

how: Won at the Parental Advisory of 17 November from Twilight Rayn, with one defence.

title: wu-2008-one-shot
